_comment: Edit `items` to change the ticker crawl, then reload the graphic. Wrap a lead-in phrase in **double asterisks** to render it in the tan accent colour. `speed` is the seconds it takes one full run of headlines to cross the screen — larger = slower, and it must grow as you add items (roughly 7s per headline reads comfortably). A `?ticker=` / `?speed=` URL param overrides whatever is in here.
